title: Evaluation of a Reindexed Sign Restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. For every sign vector $x$ of dimension $|J|$, the reindexed restriction of $f$ at $x$ equals $f$ evaluated on the full sign vector formed from the corresponding coordinates of $x$ on $J$ and the fixed signs outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$z$ assigns signs to the coordinates outside $J$
$x$ is a sign vector of dimension $|J|$
